cc-notes Codex port: implementation and local acceptance

Checkout: /Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/cc-notes/codex-ccn
Branch: yasyf/codex-ccn
Base: fb1afe6db0a67f50367b7c005299d06a5e5556a9 (HEAD equals freshly fetched origin/main)
Approved plan: cc-notes plan 486d766 in captain-hook/galeocerdo
Task: task_5d1e069b8b4e / dispatch ctx_d57de941e802
State: implemented, uncommitted, locally verified; coordinator owns review, integration and live rollout.

Implemented behavior

- CLI writes retain explicit CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID precedence, including empty suppression. Otherwise they use CODEX_THREAD_ID, then CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID. All create/append/prepare/compact/merge paths use the same request-aware session resolver; pack schema and stored records are unchanged. Code: internal/store/store.go:204#hw8x.
- MCP adds --host claude|codex, default Claude. Codex cwd ignores inherited CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; explicit --dir wins. Each Codex tools/call requires nonempty _meta.threadId, passed in context rather than process environment. Claude/default MCP binds its Claude session and ignores inherited Codex thread IDs. Explicit CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID wins for either host. Code: internal/mcpserver/session.go:14#vr76 and internal/mcpserver/server.go:91#d8g5.
- Hook CLI operations in Codex use -R evt.cwd and CODEX_THREAD_ID=evt.thread_id, retaining explicit overrides. Native MCP names are recognized across recall, approvals, entity tracking, investigation activity and task leases. Code: plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py:233#ktqr.
- Recall iterates normalized file_reads; staleness iterates every changed destination and rename source. Durable record, evidence, memory and investigation-close nudges process per-file changes without combining one file's name and another's content. Singular Claude comment checks retain full pre/post images; patch comment checks use their own fragments. Code: plugin/capt-hook/hooks/surface.py:113#ggnm, plugin/capt-hook/hooks/surface.py:149#n62s, plugin/capt-hook/hooks/record.py:324#pjjx, plugin/capt-hook/hooks/comments.py:57#yj7f.
- PostCompact stages touched records and answers through DeferredNotices; subsequent context-bearing events drain once. Codex request_user_input replies match question IDs and exclude secrets. update_plan counts unfinished native steps for durable-task nudges and does not imply plan approval. Native turn IDs scope sync and investigation counters. SubagentStop uses the actual last_assistant_message for a diagnostic-verdict nudge; spawn_agent launch acknowledgements are not treated as results. Code: plugin/capt-hook/hooks/compact.py:373#mhsa, plugin/capt-hook/hooks/answers.py:398#z42y, plugin/capt-hook/hooks/record.py:1415#dv8w.
- The Codex builder produces a separate local marketplace and cc-notes package from shared skills and capt-hook resources. It strips Claude allowed-tools frontmatter from generated skills, retains the original Claude package, and installs no second lifecycle dispatcher. Source manifests pass CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID and CC_NOTES_ACTOR through env_vars. Code: scripts/build-codex-plugin.py:10#pw8z.

API examples

CLI native provenance:
  CODEX_THREAD_ID=native-thread dist/cc-notes -R /path/to/repo note add "Fact" --body "Evidence"
Explicit suppression:
  CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID= CODEX_THREAD_ID=native-thread dist/cc-notes -R /path/to/repo note add "Fact" --body "Evidence"
Codex MCP service:
  dist/cc-notes mcp --host codex --dir /path/to/worktree
MCP request:
  {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"note_add","arguments":{"title":"Fact","body":"Evidence"},"_meta":{"threadId":"native-thread"}}}
Native plugin MCP configuration:
  {"mcpServers":{"cc-notes":{"command":"cc-notes","args":["mcp","--host","codex"],"env_vars":["CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID","CC_NOTES_ACTOR"]}}}

Runtime probe

A disposable plugin and isolated CODEX_HOME directories under dist/env-probe exercised Codex 0.155.1 app-server initialize, thread/start, mcpServerStatus/list and mcpServer/tool/call, with no turn/start or model requests. Two threads per case proved .mcp.json env_vars preserves an omitted override, an explicitly empty override, and an explicit nonempty override. Native per-call _meta.threadId and thread-specific cwd were present throughout. Only the disposable app-server processes were stopped; no live app was restarted and no user configuration/cache was changed.

Limits and coordinator integration

- Compatible local captain-hook and cc-transcript builds are required. Published pins remain real released versions as instructed; the released capt-hook version alone lacks the new API. Coordinator owns eventual release pins and signed helper/global dispatcher installation.
- Native desktop/CLI/Orca-terminal end-to-end smoke tests, shared server ownership and interactive feedback transport belong to coordinator and peer integration. This worker verified cc-notes behavior and MCP environment handling without a live rollout.
- Codex has no ExitPlanMode approval event. Approved durable plans must be recorded explicitly; update_plan is not approval. Asynchronous user questions without a completed request_user_input tool result require explicit answer_add.
- Codex multi-hunk comment checks analyze known fragments. Claude singular edits retain full-file comment-growth checks. No fabricated full-file image is inferred from unavailable patch text.
- The generated local package currently references the absolute checkout binary above. Fleet staging must preserve that path or rebuild with its final binary path; no installed global binary was replaced.
- Global captain-hook must discover the generated capt-hook pack once, with PostCompact and native lifecycle events enabled. cc-notes supplies no duplicate dispatcher.
- Remaining work: independent review and coordinator integration/live acceptance. No commits, pushes, publication, global installs, user-cache edits or live app restarts were performed.
